description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 03.10.2022 to 09.10.2022
reasoning: This gazette content is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) that establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation, and does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories (land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial).
